compared: No public item drawn from stacks-project:more-algebra.tex states the level-lowering lemma. The 57 public items of that chapter were resolved to their source labels through the project's canonical tag list; the only items of the section Eliminating ramification are public 421 (tag 0BRM, Abhyankar's lemma for tame extensions of discrete valuation rings), public 422 (tag 0EXX, tame ramification preserved under normal closure and compositum) and public 423 (tag 09II, elimination of ramification for essentially finite-type valuation-ring extensions), together with public 419 and public 420 on Galois action and the tame inertia character. None of them carries the label lemma-lowering-the-level (tag 09F5).

Public 423 is the statement that the level-lowering lemma is a tool for: it is the elimination-of-ramification conclusion for essentially finite-type valuation-ring extensions, proved further down the same chapter at source lines 35960-36069, and it is not a corollary of the present lemma in either direction. The present lemma is an auxiliary result with its own hypotheses (weakly unramified A in B, a primitive p-th root of 1 in B, the intersection condition on residue fields) and its own conclusion about the level after a base change, and the text that uses it sits at source lines 35496-35500, outside the counted spans of both cards.

Public 425 (tag 0ASI, descent of roots up to units through codimension-one unramified maps) and public 426 (tag 0ASJ, etale local extensions of valuation rings are weakly unramified) are the other same-chapter neighbours in the valuation-ring direction; they compare extensions of valuation rings or descend roots, whereas this lemma computes a new value of the level invariant after a totally ramified base change and produces the base change itself.

reference/retired-claims.json holds no record mentioning this lemma and no record from this chapter; PREPARATION_WORKLIST.jsonl contains no row whose claim_key, title or task path names it, its only more-algebra.tex rows being the two sibling cards already published from the stably free section; the pool card of this source does not print lemma-lowering-the-level among its twelve candidates; and a line-by-line scan of the whole chapter against the statement spans of every existing task card under focused-seeds leaves this label unclaimed. The sibling card DSH-alg-pseudo-coherent opened from the same chapter counts lemma-pseudo-coherent at source lines 16047-16142, in a different section, with no overlap.
